title: Nagpur Girl Kidnapped, Assaulted, and Arrested
summary: A 16-year-old girl was kidnapped and assaulted in Nagpur. The police arrested a 19-year-old man who allegedly held her captive for over 24 hours, subjected her to repeated assaults, recorded the incidents on video, and injured her with a knife. The accused is now demanding soft bedding and pizza while in jail.
